examples.text: A new platform was adopted at the party convention.
He is a slave to convention. or He is fettered by tradition.

examples.translatedText: 관례로 장례식에서는 상복을 입게 되어 있다.

examples.text: Fettered by convention, we sometimes find it hard to go our own way.
